title: Queue Concepts & BullMQ
recap: BullMQ Redis par banaya gaya Node.js job queue hai jo background task processing ko reliable banata hai. Isme exponential backoff retries, locked job heartbeat renewals, aur stalled job recovery built-in aate hain.

demos.title: BullMQ Job Lifecycle & Workers
demos.summary: Throughput, worker concurrency, backpressure, retries, and stalled job lock detection.
